verdict.rationale: Gemini docs mention memory-based personalization (docs-18) and custom 'Gems' that can be configured with specific instructions/goals (docs-9), which together approximate persistent, user-set preferences shaping responses, but there's no explicit 'custom instructions' setting applied globally across all chats like a dedicated preferences panel. missing for 10: a documented global custom-instructions/preferences setting, evidence of how granular control is, and independent confirmation that memory reliably shapes every response.
